title: 2006 HMMT February General Round 2 Problem 5
statement: If \(a, b\) are nonzero real numbers such that \(a^{2}+b^{2}=8 a b\), find the value of \(\left|\frac{a+b}{a-b}\right|\).

solutions.text:
Note that

\[\left|\frac{a+b}{a-b}\right|=\sqrt{\frac{(a+b)^{2}}{(a-b)^{2}}}=\sqrt{\frac{a^{2}+b^{2}+2 a b}{a^{2}+b^{2}-2 a b}}=\sqrt{\frac{10 a b}{6 a b}}=\frac{\sqrt{15}}{3}\]
